notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for RTIambassador::commitRegionModifications and its HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery through the standard MIM. Successful service invocation reporting and its interaction content map directly to clause 11.5.1 (Table 5 p.299 r011); the test also checks the API-declared RegionNotCreatedByThisFederate exception when the caller supplies a region created by another joined federate. It stages two adapter-valid ranges with reporting disabled, enables reporting, commits both regions, and checks the array-form set-of-region-designators argument, null return marker, success and empty-exception fields, serial zero, region service type 5, reliable delivery, and inherited HLAfederate reporter identity. It then submits a foreign-owned region, verifies the exception and its failure report with the same array argument form, and checks the failure reporter identity. The standard API readback checks the two local range values; it is not represented as a region-routing assertion or independent proof of inter-federate commit propagation. This slice does not establish complete failure-report coverage or complete clause 11.5.1 coverage. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::createRegion(DimensionHandleSet), RTIambassador::setRangeBounds(RegionHandle, DimensionHandle, RangeBounds), RTIambassador::commitRegionModifications(RegionHandleSet), RTIambassador::setServiceReportingSwitch(Boolean), and FederateAmbassador::receiveInteraction for HLAreportServiceInvocation
